repos_data.description: Fixes 535 5.7.139, 5.7.57, 5.7.30, 5.7.60. Free SMTP relay for the Exchange Online SMTP AUTH / Microsoft 365 / Office 365 Basic authentication shutdown/disabled (Dec 2026). Keeps printer scan to email, scanners, NAS and legacy apps sending: plain username/password auth, tenant audit script, per-vendor OAuth compatibility list, 21 code examples.
MCP server for the Inxmail Commerce transactional API — events, sendings, bounces, blocklist, blacklist, reactions, and delivery tracking from Claude.
MCP server for AI agents to operate Sequenzy lifecycle, campaign, and transactional email workflows.
The most complete MCP server for the Resend email API — full API coverage plus a unique debug/diagnostics layer.

Official open-source MCP server for Meser 10, the Israeli email and SMS platform. Connect your account to Claude, Cursor or any MCP client. Tools are generated from the live API contract and the server starts read-only. Listed in the official MCP registry as io.github.meser10/meser10-mcp.
